item.description: Hey HN, I'm Julius, I'm a backend engineer at Hatchet and created this demo to show off some of Hatchet's new features, primarily durable streams and serverless endpoints. Those, however, are just background details that made this significantly easier to scale. By distributing the rendering across many different nodes, orchestrated using Hatchet, it makes it possible to render quite high fidelity scenes fairly quickly. All of this would be possible on a single machine, but would be much slower without dedicated hardware (RT cores, etc). item.title: Space dust particles point to ancient heavy-oxygen water reservoir in the Kuiper belt
item.description: Way out past the asteroid belt, another belt encircles the planets in our solar system. The Kuiper belt, beyond Neptune, preserves icy bodies that escaped much of the processing experienced by objects closer to the sun. Unlike the rocky and metallic asteroid belt, Kuiper belt objects are composed mostly of frozen water, methane and ammonia, mixed with rock and dust. Fuente: Phys.org.
